description_en: Installs the CloudMonitor agent on a specified server
description_zh: 为指定服务器安装云监控插件
name: InstallCloudMonitor

parameters.help_en: The version of the CloudMonitor agent to install. You can obtain the latest CloudMonitor agent version from https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/183431.html
parameters.help_zh: 要安装的云监控插件的版本。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/183431.html获取最新的云监控插件版本
parameters.name: argus_version

parameters.help_en:
The AccessKey required to install the CloudMonitor agent. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114948.html operation to obtain this parameter.

This parameter is required only when you install the CloudMonitor agent on a non-Alibaba Cloud server
parameters.help_zh:
安装云监控插件时所需要的AccessKey。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114948.html接口获取该参数。

仅非阿里云服务器安装云监控插件需要设置此参数
parameters.name: agent_access_key

parameters.help_en:
The AccessSecret required to install the CloudMonitor agent. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114948.html operation to obtain this parameter.
This parameter is required only when you install the CloudMonitor agent on a non-Alibaba Cloud server
parameters.help_zh:
安装云监控插件时所需要的AccessSecret。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114948.html接口获取该参数。
仅非阿里云服务器安装云监控插件需要设置此参数
parameters.name: agent_secret_key

parameters.help_en: The list of instance IDs of the servers on which you want to install the CloudMonitor agent. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 要安装云监控插件的服务器的实例ID列表。多个ID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: instance_id_list

parameters.help_en: The list of UUIDs of the servers on which you want to install the CloudMonitor agent. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 要安装云监控插件的服务器的UUID列表。多个UUID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: uuid_list

Code.description_en: The error code returned when the operation failed
Code.description_zh: 接口调用失败的错误码

Message.description_en: The detailed information about the error code
Message.example: There was an error with your request.

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique ID for each request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:

true: The operation was successful.
false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功。取值：

true：接口调用成功。
false：接口调用失败
